name: Long-range Ray Marched Fog
definition: A method to compute volumetric fog for distances beyond the froxel buffer by ray marching, used to capture long-range fog and clouds without local lights or fog volumes, extending the current froxel-based solution.
summary: Long-range Ray Marched Fog computes distant volumetric fog by ray marching a simplified density field under a single directional light, offering a performance-efficient alternative to local volume solutions.
